scope: Client Lua wrapper, physical filename, logical require-path, and numeric resource-path resolution. The layers are independent and must not be collapsed into one hash scheme.

algorithm.rlu_0b: strip the 8-byte header and retain the remaining Lua 5.1 bytecode
algorithm.rle_0c: decode data[13:16] XOR 0x73 followed by data[16:] XOR 0x73
algorithm.compression: none; the rle name does not represent run-length decoding

layers.name: physical script filename

algorithm.inputNormalization: ASCII letters are lowercased; path separators and punctuation pass through
algorithm.segmentRule: apply the table independently to every path segment and preserve hierarchy
algorithm.caseBoundary: original uppercase spelling is not recoverable after case folding

layers.retailFunctionBoundary: No runtime decoder is present or required by the recovered client route. This is a pack/build-time physical-name transform recovered from the corpus, not a path hash.

layers.name: logical Lua require path

steps.action: concatenate LpbLoader+0x08 base directory and caller-supplied clear filename
on miss append the .lpb suffix through FUN_00447550
report not found and return status 2
allocate a 0x78-byte resume checker and queue asynchronous fetch

layers.loaderTail: FUN_00D08180 (BCS-Y-1810) obtains decoded bytes and reaches luaL_loadbuffer FUN_00CF4680 (BCS-Y-1812)
layers.boundary: The resolver consumes a clear logical Lua path. It does not apply the physical filename substitution or derive a numeric resource id.

layers.name: numeric resource-id DAT path
layers.byteOrder: resource-id bytes from most significant to least significant

evidence.fact: shift and mask the four input bytes

layers.boundary: The u32 resource id is an input. Its build-time origin is not recovered here, and no client string-path-to-id hash is claimed.

rejectedConflations: The physical script filename substitution is not executed by FUN_00D0CFB0.
The Lua logical require path is not a numeric SqPack resource id.
FUN_0044B3A0 formats an existing resource id and does not hash a clear path.
The Murmur2 routine used by SetActorProperty is unrelated to Lua/resource path resolution.
Later FFXIV ARR CRC32 path schemes are not evidence for the 1.23b client.
